فَاحِمٌ Black; (S, K, TA;) applied to hair, (S,) and to anything; (TA;) as also ↓ فَحِيمٌ ; (K, TA;) applied to hair and to anything. (TA.) And Black that is beautiful or comely. (TA.) ―
-b2- And one says أَسْوَدُ فَاحِمٌ meaning Black in an intense degree. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A ram uttering a cry, or cries; and so ↓ فَحِمٌ . (K. [But see 1.]) ―
-b2- And One who does not speak at all. (TA.) ―
-b3- And, applied to water, (tropical:) Still; not flowing or running. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
